roleAndGateSet.roles: Scientific reviewer for units/reference values and test reviewer for invalid inputs; independent review only if a separate agent actually returns findings. This probe used serial self-review.
roleAndGateSet.gates: Independent mass-balance reference with units, declared volume basis, fixed RRF=1, zero/invalid internal-standard area, source-row provenance, focused Node tests, adjacent Stage 0-6 regression, source hash before/after for real files, rollback diff. No raw research data mutation without authorization.

prompts.decision: The synthetic 10 uL spike is 0.01 mL, containing 1 ug internal standard. Ignoring spike volume gives 0.2 ug/mL internal standard and 0.4 ug/mL analyte extract at area ratio 2. Including spike volume gives 0.1996007984031936 ug/mL internal standard and 0.3992015968063872 ug/mL extract. The prompt does not establish whether spike volume is included. Neither branch supports ug/g without original sample mass, extraction/reconstitution volume, and dilution/recovery assumptions; report extract units only and request the missing conversion metadata before any mass-normalized result. These are synthetic calculations, not observed results.

roleAndGateSet.roles: Model QA or statistician for independence, split, feasibility, permutation and overfit claims; test reviewer for leakage checks. This probe used serial self-review and made no independent-agent claim.
roleAndGateSet.gates: Explicit biologicalUnitId and independence confirmation; aggregate technical injections within biological unit; group-disjoint split before learned transforms; training-fold-only scaling/imputation/feature selection and nested tuning; binary OPLS feasibility; held-out predictions and balanced accuracy with uncertainty; seeded full-pipeline unit-label permutations, requested/completed/failed counts; focused R regression and independent model QA before real performance claims.

prompts.decision: Reject whole-table learned standardization and injection-level random split as leakage. For an explicit synthetic binary illustration with 2 classes x 3 biological units/class x 2 injections/unit, enumerating every 6-vs-6 injection partition gives 924 partitions, 904 with a biological unit on both sides and 20 group-intact partitions. The prompt does not specify the class count; project OPLS-DA requires two classes. Three independent units/class is exploratory and the existing 3+3 OPLS fixture returns NO_VALID_CANDIDATE. No training data, seed, held-out predictions, or model fit was supplied, so no accuracy can be reported. The project's empirical permutation p=(1+exceedances)/(B+1) has minimum 1/21=0.047619047619047616 at B=20; p=0.01 is impossible even with zero exceedances, and failures make p unavailable.
irrelevantSkillsOmitted: flavor-gcms-processing: no GC-MS calculation is changed
